entities.name: Chatzuk
entities.description: Legendary human bard of Dominaria who lived before 4073 AR, associated with the Helm of Chatzuk and often invoked in expletives by Gull.

entities.name: Helm of Chatzuk
entities.description: Skull-like helm named after Chatzuk that grants banding.

entities.name: Gull
entities.description: Character known for frequently invoking Chatzuk's name with expletives.

relations.note: The helm is named after Chatzuk.
relations.quote: a skull-like helm named after them called the Helm of Chatzuk that grants banding
